task.title: Reporting a Cybersecurity Incident
task.shortdesc: Reporting a cybersecurity incident to the NC State Help Desk is quick and easy.

context.p: Anyone in the campus community can report a .

ul.li: Date and time of the incident

Specific computer information, if available:
Computer name
Computer IP address
Computer logs

step.cmd: Send an email with the gathered information to the NC State Help Desk at help@ncsu.edu or call the help desk at (919) 515-4357.

info.note: Report criminal activity (such as theft) to the Campus Police Department by calling (919) 515-3000. Contact NC State's Security and Compliance Cybersecurity Operations team for assistance with connecting to external law enforcement agencies (such as the FBI).
